title: passovia bisexualis
intro: Passovia bisexualis, commonly known as Passiflora, is a type of flowering plant native to South America. It is a species of passionflower, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The Passiflora plant offers various health benefits, including reducing anxiety and insomnia, and has been used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Passiflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, analgesia, and anti-inflammatory effects.
